newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia crude palm oil price down at tender.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia crude palm oil price down at tender.

text.p: Indonesian crude palm oil (CPO) prices declined further at a tender on Monday, traders said.
One trader said the 1,000-tonne CPO tender in Medan was done at 1,075 rupiah/kg, excluding tax and transport costs, compared with 1,139 rupiah/kg at the last tender two weeks ago.
Traders said soft domestic prices were due to declines in the Malaysian market.
Ready olein was quoted at around 1,390 rupiah/kg in Medan and at 1,440-50 rupiah/kg in Jakarta and Surabaya.
Olein for October delivery was quoted at 1,425 rupiah/kg in Jakarta. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
